contentHtml:
QATAR—Sidra Medicine will host the second Qatar Advancements in Pediatric Excellence (QAPEX 2026) conference on December 4 and 5 at Andaz Doha to promote clinical innovation, professional development, and collaboration in paediatric healthcare.

The conference, organised by the Qatar Foundation member, will run under the theme “Shaping the Future of Child Health Through Innovation, Collaboration, and Excellence.”

It follows the inaugural 2025 edition and aims to strengthen paediatric healthcare delivery in Qatar and the wider Middle East through scientific exchange and multidisciplinary training.

QAPEX 2026 will bring together paediatricians, physicians, researchers, nurses, pharmacists, allied health professionals and healthcare executives to discuss emerging medical developments and challenges affecting children’s health.

Dr Ahmed Al-Hammadi, Chair of Pediatrics at Sidra Medicine and head of the conference’s scientific committee, said collaboration and continuous professional development remain essential to improving paediatric care.

He noted that the conference would connect emerging scientific evidence with clinical practice, giving healthcare professionals practical knowledge to improve diagnosis, treatment decisions and patient outcomes.

Focus on emerging paediatric healthcare priorities

The two-day programme will feature more than 25 interactive presentations, plenary lectures, expert panel discussions, practical workshops and breakout sessions led by regional and international specialists.

Topics will include childhood obesity, food allergies, neurological disorders, congenital infections, gene therapy, precision medicine and the use of digital technologies in children’s healthcare.

The workshops will focus on clinical decision-making, early diagnosis, referral pathways and evidence-based treatment.

Participants will also examine developments in paediatric research and clinical guidelines, with particular attention to their application in routine patient care.

The programme reflects growing interest in specialised paediatric services, particularly as advances in genetic medicine, precision diagnostics and digital health create new opportunities for earlier diagnosis and more targeted treatment.

Supporting healthcare workforce development

QAPEX 2026 forms part of Sidra Medicine’s broader efforts to strengthen specialist healthcare services and develop clinical expertise in Qatar.

The initiative also supports the objectives of Qatar National Vision 2030, which prioritises human development and a sustainable healthcare system.

The conference will offer 14 Continuing Professional Development (CPD) hours. It will take place in person, with virtual participation available to healthcare professionals based outside Qatar.
